heading: Ralph Groves for Congress, 2026
text: Vote for RALPH GROVES, the Libertarian Party candidate in Florida’s 11th Congressional District

heading: Ralph Groves for Congress, 2026
text: I'm Ralph Groves, recent Chairman of the Libertarian Party of Orange County. As a Libertarian, I'm not a Democrat, not a Republican, not Left, not Right. Instead, I'm a Constitutionalist and pragmatic. In addition, I'm a pro-natalist. I'm especially dedicated to two issues: pro-human rights and pro-2nd Amendment.

heading: Ralph Groves ’ Experiences
text: Goal: Libertarian Party of Florida candidacy for congressional office

heading: Ralph Groves ’ Experiences
text: Work Experience: Retired since 2018; active in civic matters, especially the Libertarian Party of Florida; authorship of books under the auspices of Groves & Associates Research.

heading: Ralph Groves ’ Experiences
text: 1999 – 2018: Department of Defense, civilian analyst for the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) Security clearance: Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information

heading: Ralph Groves ’ Experiences
text: 1999 – 2015, Royal Air Force Base, Molesworth, England – Analyst of social, economic, and political matters of Francophone West African countries: Cote d’Ivoire, Mali, and Senegal – including the insurgency in Casamance. Served as a member of a team that advised President Obama on Senegal prior to his visit to that country in 2013. Wrote Report for United States Congress on Cote d'Ivoire's internal political stability, 2014. As collateral duty, he served as an adjunct faculty member of the Regional Joint Intelligence Training Facility. Awarded The Joint Civilian Service Commendation Award, 2015 ​ ​

heading: Ralph Groves ’ Experiences
text: 2015 – 2018, DIA Headquarters, Bolling Air Force Base, Washington DC, including a one-year assignment at the Pentagon – Analyst of social, economic, and political matters of Iran. Main accomplishments: Contributed to several Presidential Daily Briefings for President Trump on Iran’s internal matters, especially on the 2017 – 2018 protests against the Islamist regime; Lead analyst of relations between Iran and Armenia.

heading: Ralph Groves ’ Experiences
text: Military Experience: Active duty military service in the USA and Germany prior to civilian service as an analyst for the Department of Defense. During active duty, served with Military Intelligence Group-Europe, Heidelberg, Germany. During DoD civilian service, retained affiliation with the U.S. Army via the Army Reserve. Served as a Detachment Commander in the 209th Army Liaison Team, Wiesbaden, Germany. Mobilized with the 209th for active duty in Iraq War, 2008-2009. Served in Baghdad on staff of General Petraeus. Retired from U.S. Army at rank of Major, 2010.
